policy_rule: Caller probes omit any system role message unless explicitly labeled as a system-prompted comparison cell (e.g. *-hfstock-*). Because local chat templates and third-party inference hosts may still inject default system text, analyses requiring strictly bare user-only instruction framing must filter on strict_bare_instruction_eligible == true (and exclude sample_level_exclusions_for_strict_bare where present), while analyses of out-of-the-box stock serving may include publisher_default_persona cells.
